newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: St Barbara has record qtr gold production.
newsitem.headline: St Barbara has record qtr gold production.

text.p: St Barbara Mines Ltd said on Wednesday it achieved record gold production of 33,248 ounces in the March quarter, bringing nine-months output to 102,184 ounces, up from 92,611 a year earlier.
"Production would have been higher but for the effects of heavy rain during February when 138mm of rain fell over 11 days," the company said in its March quarter report.
The cash operating cost was A$397 per ounce against A$455 a year earlier.

The company, which on Tuesday withdrew a bid for Mt Leyshon Mines Ltd, said costs were in line with budget in all areas with the exception of the treatment plant where there were cost overruns mainly due to a catchup maintenance programme.
"The benefit of this programme is expected to become apparent in the next two quarters through improved equipment availability and reduced ongoing maintenance costs," it said.

Unaudited pre-tax profit for the year to date was A$5.5 million against A$13.6 million a year earlier which included a profit of A$12.1 million on closing out part of a structured forward sales programme.
The nine-month net operating surplus was $A20.3 million ($A3.7 million for the quarter).
Forward sales as of March 31 totalled 76,208 ounces at an average price of A$568 per ounce with delivery dates ranging from April 1, 1997 to March 1, 1998, the company said.
